# gdrive_shared_drive (Resource)

A Shared Drive. Destruction only supports empty drives and requires deletion_protection=false.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gdrive_shared_drive" "engineering" {
  name                = "Engineering"
  domain_users_only   = true
  drive_members_only  = true
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Shared Drive name.

### Optional

- `admin_managed_restrictions` (Boolean) Require administrative privileges to modify restrictions. Omit to preserve the server setting.
- `copy_requires_writer_permission` (Boolean) Disable copy, print, and download for readers and commenters. Omit to preserve the server setting.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Blocks deletion. Apply false in a separate operation before destroying this resource.
- `domain_users_only` (Boolean) Restrict access to domain users. Omit to preserve the server setting.
- `drive_members_only` (Boolean) Restrict item access to drive members. Omit to preserve the server setting.
- `sharing_folders_requires_organizer_permission` (Boolean) Require Manager role to share folders. Omit to preserve the server setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Google Drive resource ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import gdrive_shared_drive.engineering SHARED_DRIVE_ID
```
